external_deps: AI CLI (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Qwen)

review.tagline: Job-search agent that scores postings against your CV and drafts applications
review.summary: Runs inside an AI coding CLI (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Qwen and others). You paste a job URL or text and it checks the posting is still live, scores fit against your CV, and drafts a tailored ATS PDF, cover letter and form answers. It never submits or sends anything; data stays local apart from calls to the AI provider you choose. It also has a portal scanner, a terminal dashboard and batch evaluation.
review.audience: Job seekers comfortable running an AI CLI in a terminal
strengths: Drafts only: no auto-submit and no mail transport in the code, per the README
No telemetry or backend; CV goes only to your chosen AI provider
Portal scanner preconfigured for 100+ companies across Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever and Wellfound
Works with several AI CLIs and can use local or free-tier models
weaknesses: Requires an AI CLI and a model provider; output quality depends on the model
README says early runs are rough until it learns your profile
CV rewording check cannot catch every fabrication; manual review required
Playwright Chromium needed for PDF generation
needs: Needs Node.js, Playwright Chromium, AI CLI (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Qwen)
Models: Claude, Codex, OpenCode, Qwen, local models
